// Package safeio may call os.Open and os.ReadFile because it is where the size
// and symlink checks live. The other forbidden calls are still rejected.
package safeio

import "os"

// Open calls os.Open where it is allowed.
func Open() (*os.File, error) {
	return os.Open("fixture")
}

// ReadAll calls os.ReadFile where it is allowed.
func ReadAll() ([]byte, error) {
	return os.ReadFile("fixture")
}

// Crash stops protection where it hurts most.
func Crash() {
	panic("fixture") // want: forbidigo
}
